envelope.sourceCitation: FAA Coversheet for 8500-8 Additional Information; corroborated verbatim by AOPA 'How and where to submit to the FAA' and the 2026 Guide for Aviation Medical Examiners (updated 2026-06-24).

contactNote: Phone (405) 954-4821 · Fax (405) 954-4300 (fax only for fewer than 20 pages; no EKG or imaging).
mailingNotes: The FAA and AOPA advise using a courier with signed proof of delivery (overnight or registered) for time-sensitive Special Issuance reports.
The FAA states that status reports must come from your treating physician; a report you write yourself is not accepted.
The FAA advises keeping a copy of everything and sending it as a single packet.
Your own FAA Authorization letter is the authority on which reports are required and when.
